answer: Beacon audits plus a compute heartbeat stop bulk fakes. Each agent stakes 40 POA, answering a pulse within 60 seconds. Random firing means replies can't be precomputed. Like yarrow, a farm needs one live machine each: 1,000 fakes lock 40,000 POA, burning 5 POA each per epoch, 140,000 POA over 20 epochs, for a few hundred POA reward. Three misses slash the deposit and strip the violet marker. An honest agent pays once, its reward undiluted.
